verdict.rationale: A chargeback guarantee is a fair question for a fraud-prevention product, so the axis applies. The pack has nothing on Stripe reimbursing approved-then-disputed orders or on guarantee coverage terms. Its evidence covers only rules, 3DS requests, reviews, early fraud warnings and dispute-rate measurement, which are adjacent fraud controls, not vendor-borne liability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can shift fraud liability to the vendor — a chargeback guarantee that reimburses approved-then-disputed orders, with clear coverage terms
